architecture.non_duplication_rule: The Guide MUST reference POLIS Specification machine contracts and MUST NOT create alternative package layouts, launchers, manifest templates, status algorithms, or apply protocols.

sdd: Write or revise one versioned behavior specification before production implementation.
Define observable acceptance criteria, invariants, forbidden states, inputs, outputs, and failure semantics.
Treat the accepted specification as normative until explicitly revised.
tdd: Select the next smallest observable behavior from the accepted specification.
Write and execute a test that fails for the expected behavior-specific reason.
Implement the smallest sufficient production change.
Execute the new test, affected tests, and complete suite until green.
Refactor only while relevant behavior remains green.
Record observed Red and Green evidence for AI-authored implementation slices.

delivery_workflow: Orient and resolve authority, repository identity, permissions, objective, changed behavior, protected behavior, and non-goals.
Inspect repository policy, current behavior, tests, CI, architecture, contracts, and material runtime evidence.

If the repository has no POLIS policy and matches a supported canonical profile, invoke polis init, review the generated policy, and commit that policy before delivery work; never let a delivery silently redefine its own validation contract.

Create a Change Contract outside the worktree before implementation. behavior and affected commands are mandatory; defect changes MUST declare red_green regression with an exact failing exit code and output oracle.
For a defect, write the regression test while the defect still exists and invoke polis capture-red before the production fix. Treat the resulting regression patch as immutable input to build.
Run repository-required affected and complete validation.
On an agent-owned worktree with no staged changes, invoke canonical polis build with project identity, change identity, Change Contract, and the captured regression patch for defects.
Accept a delivery artifact only when canonical polis verify accepts the exact generated bytes and exact evidence trace.
For consumer application, use canonical polis apply on an exact clean baseline; apply MUST reproduce defect Red and target Green in isolation before modifying consumer files.

implemented: strict seven-member POLIS package format v2 verification
strict manifest validation with explicit Git SHA-1/SHA-256 object format and SHA-256 binding for policy, Change Contract, regression probe, and payload
strict Change Contract v1 with mandatory behavior and affected commands
machine-enforced defect Red-to-Green regression contract with exact baseline exit code and output tokens
canonical regression probe capture through polis capture-red without staging, commit, reset, stash, or source-tree mutation
strict canonical project-policy schema v2 and gate ordering
exact PASS evidence-trace reconstruction from Change Contract plus project policy
coverage evidence arithmetic validation and strict greater-than threshold semantics
direct argv command execution without a shell
temporary-index package construction including untracked non-ignored files
isolated patch validation and exact target-tree verification
consumer-side re-execution of Change Contract and project policy before transactional apply
transactional prevalidated polis apply that preserves HEAD and the real index
consumer evidence stored under Git metadata
normative go-coverprofile-v1 line-coverage adapter using project-wide -coverpkg instrumentation in the canonical Go profile
canonical polis init policy bootstrap for root-level Go modules
not_yet_production_complete: cross-platform runtime validation outside the currently executed Linux environment
current_alpha_boundary.rule: Implemented alpha capabilities MUST be executable and tested. Cross-compilation alone is not runtime evidence for a platform.

coverage.rule: Exactly 80.0 percent is FAIL. Policy schema v2 requires a runtime-owned coverage adapter; V4.0.0 implements go-coverprofile-v1 and the canonical Go profile instruments all project packages with -coverpkg=./... before POLIS computes line_coverage_percent.

quality_gates.tests: The complete authoritative project test suite MUST pass before delivery PASS.
quality_gates.tdd_evidence: When implementation is claimed as TDD-driven, observed Red and Green command evidence MUST be recorded.
quality_gates.formatting_static_build: Repository-required formatting, static analysis, lint, typecheck, build, compatibility, security, migration, platform, and smoke gates MUST be represented by the canonical project policy rather than invented per delivery.

polis_boundary.guide_rule: The Guide determines engineering process and evidence obligations.
polis_boundary.spec_rule: The POLIS Specification alone defines machine-readable package and runtime contracts.
polis_boundary.runtime_rule: The POLIS CLI computes deterministic outcomes from package bytes, schemas, Git state, direct process results, and exact tree identity.
polis_boundary.conflict_rule: If Guide prose conflicts with the versioned POLIS Specification for machine-level semantics, the POLIS Specification governs and the Guide MUST be corrected.
